verifications.note: Read from the file: plant L100000401830

Status.note: Status is unchanged. The EIA-860M table for September 2026 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx) lists plant 55270, generators 7EA, LM1 to LM6, ST1 and ST2, all operating since July 2002, with no planned retirement. I found no retirement, mothballing or sale announced.

Equipment Manufacturer/Model.note: A state air permit staff report from October 2025 (https://mienviro.michigan.gov/ncore/downloadpdf/-3244922643802319973) names six GE LM6000 turbines at the plant. It does not name the model of the larger seventh turbine. The EIA generator code 7EA suggests a GE 7EA, but no document states it, so that is not reported.

units.notes: The unit is still operating. Latest Activity is left blank because GEM only fills it for units in development or shelved.
